:::{#def-reduction}
#### Polynomial-time reduction

A [decision problem](p-and-np.qmd#def-decision-problem) $L$
**reduces in polynomial time** to a decision problem $L'$, written $L \le_p L'$,
if there is a function $f \colon \{0, 1\}^* \to \{0, 1\}^*$,
computable in [polynomial time](p-and-np.qmd#def-running-time),
such that for every $x \in \{0, 1\}^*$,

$$x \in L \quad \text{if and only if} \quad f(x) \in L'$$

[@arora2009computational, section 2.2].

:::
